verdicts.reason: A breaks the core idea of the design: the floral wreath that framed the text circle is now an empty ring on the far left, the white text disc is a separate object in the middle, and a large dead black area fills the right third. Still, it keeps the key floral imagery at a sensible size. B loses the wreath almost completely: it shrinks to an unreadable speck near the lower left, leaving only a plain white circle of text on black, so the brand look and the main imagery are effectively gone.
